messages:
laura: quick nag noticed routing mismatches after new client release — calls show header X-Route: beta but quota ledger charges stable pool.

ben: can you share sample headers? could be canonicalization or encoding change.

laura: repro curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer SSS' \
  -H 'X-Route: beta' \
  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

cecil: replayed span id s-77a4. gateway sees "x-route" lowercase. our fast-path policy matcher does case-sensitive lookup.

anya: we recently introduced header normalization in TS SDK to de-dupe headers, this likely lowercases keys before sending.

laura: exact. console traces still surface expected route (routehint=beta) but billing shows pool stable-1 bumped.

ben: short-term fix: (1) revert SDK lowercase normalization in next patch, (2) make gateway lookup case-insensitive fallback and emit metric, (3) add console alert & tile to surface mismatches by tenant.

cecil: I can push tolerant matching and add metric routing.header_case_mismatch. will canary it to infra canary group.

anya: i'll cut the TS client revert PR and a changelog blurb about header behavior. laura, can you do python patch too?

laura: yep, cutting py PR now.

infra-bot: Deploy started: tolerant-router-fix -> canary (4 nodes) by cecil at 6173500100

ben: also plan integration test that spins up sdk->gateway->router to catch this in CI.

cecil: adding unit tests and a small console query: SELECT tenant, count(*) FROM routing_mismatch WHERE ts > now()-1d GROUP BY tenant.

anya: console tile sketch: columns: tenant | route_sent | pool_charged | mismatch_rate(24h). alert if >0.2%.

laura: summary: revert client normalization -> release patches; deploy gateway tolerant match canary now; add metric and console tile; monitor 48h. tagging @ben @cecil @anya.
